_doc: M5 map workstream P10 - THE 'NOW USABLE' MAP SHORTCUT. UI CONTENT: Sim.Ui reads it, nothing in the simulation does, and no value here can change a world hash. The shortcut is offered when the PLAYER'S completed knowledge makes a content-declared entity knowledge-eligible that it was not before (an eligibility TRANSITION observed by UiSession.Step between the world a step began from and the world it produced) AND that eligibility changes what the simulation does with a deposit or the land: (1) a goods.json recipe linked to a research entity (recipes[].entity) whose inputs include deposit goods (goods.json depositChannel) that no recipe the player knew before consumed - the recipe now converts them (CraftingQuery.IsKnown, the one recipe knowledge predicate ProductionSystem computes with); (2) a sector's researched identity listed in sectorLayers below whose eligibility the production yield reads (LabourActivities.HarvestsWildFood - the farming sector with sim.json farming.preCultivation on; the other sectors' identities are labels only, ADR-033 D1, and never fire). No research node or entity id is named in code: the entities come from goods.json and research.json, the overlay layer from here. The shortcut opens the P9 overlay layer(s) the entity's goods are drawn on (a deposit good's channel; a sector's layer from sectorLayers) and outlines the places on it the player KNOWS (P7) where the value is above 0. It is labelled 'now usable', never 'discovered': the simulation has no knowledge of a resource (every deposit is known wherever its ground is known) and no research gates extraction (ADR-033 D1); what fired is the permission to USE.
_docExpiryTurns: TUNE, CHOSEN (not derived; presentation only): the shortcut is offered while the world's clock reads less than T + expiryTurns, T being the clock of the state the completing step wrote (the turn just played, PlayerTurn) - so it is shown while the player plays turns T+1 .. T+expiryTurns and is gone, turn-exactly, when the clock reaches T + expiryTurns. Turns, not years: it is a UI reminder and the player meets it once per End Turn whatever the step length. 5 = long enough to be seen across a few End Turns, short enough that a list of reminders does not accumulate. The overlay layer itself stays available forever through the OVERLAYS controls (permanent manual access); only the shortcut and its outline expire. Must be at least 1.

sectorLayers._doc: research.json sectorActivities 'farming' (its researched identity replaces Gathering). With sim.json farming.preCultivation on, the farming yield's land side reads the catchment's fertility-weighted arable km2 at the cultivated yield instead of the wild one once the identity is eligible (ProductionSystem.Farm through LabourActivities.HarvestsWildFood). The P9 'fertility' layer (Region fertility: the terrain Fertility raster summed around each place, the siting score's factor) is the overlay of that same raster; it is not the catchment's arable area, which the place card (P8) states.
